query_text: Propose an image or an event that defines the twentieth century.

content.text:
One defining image of the twentieth century: **the mushroom cloud over Hiroshima on August 6, 1945**.

It captures several of the century’s central themes at once: industrialized warfare, scientific genius turned toward mass destruction, the moral crisis of modern technology, the end of World War II, the beginning of the nuclear age, and the Cold War fear that humanity had gained the power to destroy itself.

If I had to name a defining **event**, I’d choose **the detonation of the first atomic bombs in 1945**—especially Hiroshima and Nagasaki—because they marked a permanent change in history: after that moment, global politics, military strategy, ethics, science, and even everyday imagination were shaped by the possibility of nuclear annihilation.
